proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.fixed_save_dc
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item spell grants currently record only spell id and charge-cast mode. This item's cast uses a fixed item DC, which materially changes spell resolution and cannot be omitted honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend 1 charge to cast Polymorph (save DC 15) from it.

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunement_restriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The record can only say whether attunement is required, not who may attune. This item restricts attunement to spellcasters.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wand, Very Rare (Requires Attunement by a Spellcaster)

notes: The top-level magic_item activation family fits, but I did not author content because the fixed Polymorph save DC 15 is a blocking surface gap. Recharge and destruction fit existing shapes.
